payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased using utterances with negative system responses.

claims.text: Confidences of incorrectly predicted domains are decreased by leveraging utterances with negative system responses, particularly when those domains are among the top predictions.
The approach formulates a loss function that demotes the confidences of the highest-ranked negative ground-truth domains to mitigate incorrect predictions.
The method aims to reduce confirmation bias caused by treating irrelevant top predictions as valid labels during model training.
